tools.name: create_key
tools.description: Get an API key (no email, no human). Put it in the Authorization header as 'Bearer <key>'.

tools.name: list_owners
tools.description: List the owners this key manages.

tools.name: create_owner
tools.description: Create an owner: the person whose booking pages these are.

tools.name: update_owner
tools.description: Change an owner's name, time zone, intro or hours.

tools.name: set_hours
tools.description: Set an owner's weekly hours and date exceptions (wall-clock, in the owner's zone).

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a booking page (a kind of meeting): length, custom fields, places per time, holds.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Change a booking page.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List an owner's booking pages.

tools.name: get_free_times
tools.description: Free times of a page, grouped by day. from/to are dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in tz.

tools.name: add_block
tools.description: Block a time for an owner ('away Friday afternoon').

tools.name: delete_block
tools.description: Remove a block.

tools.name: set_busy
tools.description: Replace one source's busy times (from the owner's own calendar) for a range.

tools.name: create_link
tools.description: A personal booking link for one client: name filled in, one use, an expiry date.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings. Filters: owner, page, from, to (dates), status, changed_since.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: One booking.

tools.name: book
tools.description: Book for the owner (a client who phoned). force: true books outside the hours.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking. The service tells nobody: you tell the client.

tools.name: move_booking
tools.description: Move a booking to another start time.

tools.name: confirm_booking
tools.description: Confirm a requested booking (pages with confirm: agent).

tools.name: decline_booking
tools.description: Decline a requested booking.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Events after a given id: booking.created, confirmed, declined, expired, cancelled, moved.

tools.name: erase_client
tools.description: Erase a client's details from every booking of this key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_key" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get an API key (no email, no human). Put it in the Authorization header as 'Bearer <key>'.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_key · Private data: create_key · Public sink: create_key · Destructive: delete_block.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_key · Private data: create_key · Public sink: create_key · Destructive: delete_block

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
